predecessor_evidence.rule: B0 evidence is immutable development-visible evidence. B1 uses only newly frozen task variants and newly produced attempts; no B0 output may be copied, seeded, relabelled, rescored, or rerun as B1 evidence.

purpose: Held-out generalization diagnostic for the post-B0/P7 TracePixel architecture on newly frozen constrained small pixel assets; not a universal art-quality or production-readiness claim.

scored_methods.description: Post-P7 TracePixel staged Agent surface. Required authoring stages must be explicitly applied or skipped before completion; deterministic findings may enter the bounded P7 localization/repair path before final QA.

Matched low-level baseline using the same provider/model and visible task information but without TracePixel stage, localization, or repair guidance. It receives only the v1 PixelProgram set_pixels surface plus the same task-applicable deterministic QA feedback between bounded revisions.

non_scored_baselines.reason: No newly frozen equally pinned dependency/runtime adapter is included in B1-F0; do not manufacture a scored competitor from an unmatched environment.
No direct matched B1 adapter is frozen.
Owner gate G5 remains unresolved; inclusion as a scored B1 baseline is forbidden.
No matched image-generation provider/settings/postprocess recipe is frozen for B1.

Center it, keep at least 1 transparent pixel of margin on every side, use at most 7 visible colors, make the complete visible shape vertically symmetric, keep it as one connected visible component, and leave no isolated visible pixels.

Create a small campfire with a warm orange flame above dark crossed logs on a 16x16 transparent canvas. Keep at least 1 transparent pixel of margin on every side, use at most 7 visible colors, keep the campfire as one connected visible component, and leave no isolated visible pixels.

Center it, keep at least 1 transparent pixel of margin on every side, use at most 8 visible colors, make the complete visible shape vertically symmetric, keep it as one connected visible component, and leave no isolated visible pixels.

held_out_boundary.selection_rule: B1 task IDs and visible task texts are newly frozen after P7 and must not equal any B0 task ID or visible_text.
held_out_boundary.asset_output_rule: Generation prompts, adapters, and scored execution must not read, copy, seed from, or transform B0 final RGBA/PNG outputs.
held_out_boundary.development_reference_rule: B0 postmortem may inform architecture and benchmark design, but B0 attempt outputs and owner scores are not B1 scored evidence.
held_out_boundary.no_score_improving_rerun: B0 attempts are never rerun or relabelled. B1 unsuccessful attempts are retained under their original scheduled identity.

information_matching.rule: Every scored method receives the exact same B1 task visible_text and no method receives hidden_structural_constraints as prompt text. Method-specific instructions may only describe that method's frozen authoring surface and output schema.
information_matching.deterministic_feedback: After an accepted revision, both methods may receive the same task-applicable deterministic QA facts. TracePixel-specific stage/localization/repair state is exposed only to tracepixel-post-p7-v1 because it is the architecture under test.
information_matching.human_feedback_during_generation: disabled for the scored B1-v1 cohort; repository-owner review occurs only after generation so method comparison is not confounded by selective interactive hints.

budgets.pixel_edit_budget_semantics: Cumulative across accepted proposals; 2048 permits at most eight full 16x16 canvas-equivalent edit passes. The larger B1 ceiling exists so the post-P7 staged method can traverse all six staged authoring steps and still retain bounded repair headroom.
budgets.api_cost_policy: No separately metered API-key billing is permitted. The frozen provider boundary is the existing ChatGPT-authenticated Codex CLI plan; api_cost_usd_micros remains null when the provider exposes no per-call price.

retry_policy.transport_retry: At most one identical-request retry is allowed only when a provider/transport failure returns no usable proposal bytes. Both call records are retained and the retry consumes the same trial's provider-call budget.

exclusion_policy.after_provider_invocation: No scored attempt is excluded after provider invocation; provider, validation, verifier, semantic, timeout and budget failures remain failures in the result set.
exclusion_policy.pre_invocation_harness_failure: A demonstrable harness/setup failure before provider invocation may be marked void_infrastructure and rerun once with the same attempt ID plus a rerun suffix. The original record must remain retained and the reason/fix commit must be recorded.
exclusion_policy.cross_cohort_substitution: Forbidden: no B0 attempt or output may replace a scheduled B1 attempt.

deterministic_scoring.per_rule: Each frozen task-applicable structural rule is binary pass/fail from deterministic QA only.
deterministic_scoring.per_trial_structural_fraction: passed_applicable_rules / applicable_rules; missing or unusable final output scores 0.
deterministic_scoring.per_trial_structural_pass: true only when every applicable structural rule passes.
deterministic_scoring.completion: true only when the method returns a harness-valid final artifact within all frozen budgets, regardless of whether every structural rule passes.
deterministic_scoring.stage_completion_for_tracepixel: Reported separately: every required authoring stage must be explicitly applied or skipped before tracepixel-post-p7-v1 may claim authoring completion. It is not folded into the deterministic structural fraction.
deterministic_scoring.aggregation: For each method report scheduled trial count, completion rate, structural-pass rate, and arithmetic mean structural fraction across all scheduled non-void trials. Failed/non-completing trials remain in denominators and contribute zero structural fraction. void_infrastructure records are reported separately and never silently removed.
deterministic_scoring.tie_breaking: No single winner is declared from a composite score; completion, deterministic structure, stage coverage, repair cost, complexity and human perception remain separate result layers.

complexity_reporting.method_specific_null_policy: Stage/repair-only fields that do not apply to the raw baseline remain explicit null/not-applicable values rather than fabricated equivalents.
complexity_reporting.aggregation: Report per-trial raw values plus method median and arithmetic mean for token/tool/iteration/revision/changed-pixel/wall-time fields where numeric. Preserve stage coverage and repair evidence separately. Do not omit failed trials; unavailable provider metrics remain explicit nulls rather than guessed values.

perceptual_evaluation.vlm_judge: disabled; owner gate G4 remains unresolved and no VLM score enters B1-v1
perceptual_evaluation.blind_order: For each task, review artifacts are displayed without method names and ordered by ascending SHA-256 of '<task_id>|<trial_index>|<method_id>'.
perceptual_evaluation.scale: integer 1-5 per dimension, where 1 is poor and 5 is strong
perceptual_evaluation.rejection: The evaluator may mark human_rejection, but human scores never override deterministic structural facts.

human_intervention_policy.during_generation: No prompt edits, manual pixel edits, method-specific hints, selective reruns or early stopping based on appearance.
human_intervention_policy.after_generation: The owner may perform the frozen blind perceptual rating only; review does not mutate outputs. Any later P7-style interactive repair study requires a separately frozen protocol and is not silently folded into B1-v1.

artifact_retention.storage: Commit the complete sanitized scored evidence under evidence/b1/results/<freeze-commit>/<method>/<task>/<trial>/ or an equivalently immutable path. Authentication material and secrets are never retained.
artifact_retention.hashing: Attempt manifests record SHA-256 for retained byte artifacts and cite the B1-F0 freeze commit plus repository_commit_under_test.
artifact_retention.unsuccessful_attempts: Retained with the same identity and failure category; never replaced by a later successful attempt.
artifact_retention.b0_separation: No retained B1 attempt file may be sourced by copying a B0 scored output into the B1 result tree.

execution_environment.portable_ci_role: CI may validate the B1 freeze, harness/schema/replay and provider-free fixtures without provider/network access; scored provider runs are not portable-CI correctness gates.

immutability.scoring_start_condition: No B1 scored attempt may begin until the commit on main that first contains this exact file is recorded as the B1-F0 freeze commit.
immutability.after_first_scored_attempt: This B1 cohort, task text, constraints, methods, provider settings, budgets, retry/exclusion rules, scoring and trial count are immutable. Any improvement belongs after B1-P0 and may not be used to rerun or relabel this cohort.
immutability.b0_boundary: B0 remains frozen at its recorded commits and is never mutated, rerun, rescored or substituted into B1.
immutability.p8_boundary: Only after B1-P0 may the benchmark postmortem recommend explicit P8 promotions. B1-F0 does not silently add humanoid, animation, Trace2D, VLM, Aseprite/MCP, or self-hosted-runner scope.
